description: This file implements functions for parsing display configuration flags and generating display configurations for the Cuttlefish Android emulator. It includes functions to parse individual display settings from string flags and aggregate multiple display configurations from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ParseDisplayConfig
methods.description: Parses a string flag representing display parameters into a DisplayConfig object, extracting width, height, dpi, refresh rate, and overlays.

methods.name: ParseDisplayConfigsFromArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract multiple display configurations based on display flags.
